coach.1.start: Tap an arrow to fire it.
coach.2.blocked: Blocked by another arrow. Off the tutorial, that costs a heart.
coach.3.start: One block, two lanes: either lane can peel it.
coach.3.bounced: Wrong colour, so it bounced back. Off the tutorial, that costs a heart. Match the top layer.
coach.5.start: Blocks are layered. The edges along the inside show what is underneath.
coach.8.start: Hearts pay for mistakes. Finish without one for three stars.
coach.20.start: One heart. Read the board before every tap.
coach.35.start: A Joker takes any colour — but it still needs a clear path.
coach.45.start: The clock is the budget here. A mistake costs five seconds, not a heart.
coach.42.start: A Bomb peels its block and both neighbours, whatever the colour.
coach.55.start: A Ghost fires straight through the tangle — the colour still has to match.
coach.colourBlind: Colours hard to tell apart? Settings has a colour-blind mode that marks each one with a shape.
